title: Netflix TV v1.4.7
changelog: Fixed playback for titles like The Good Lawyer: native MPEG-TS proxying and unblocking for fcxmb.com streams
Removed aggressive backup button auto-clicker in WebView that forced FrameX into the backup player
Fixed Server 2 (AutoEmbed): migrated from broken vidlink.pro to player.autoembed.me, eliminating Next.js client-side exceptions

Restored Server Remote Virtual Cursor mode & Android native touch event dispatch (dispatchPointerClick) for full TV remote interaction with all embedded server controls (Super barbarian XVI, FrameX, AutoEmbed)
Fixed Who's Watching profile selection: viewport overflow, initial focus assertion on BOLT, and D-pad remote navigation
Fixed Search Screen: always visible TV QWERTY keyboard (removed hidden lg:block) with bidirectional remote navigation and focusable search input
Completely removed phone-to-TV casting UI and modals from the Android TV app while preserving actor/cast credits
